intro: Down the Rabbit Hole AUST provides garden maintenance Canberra ACT homeowners, landlords and strata committees can put on a schedule and stop thinking about. Regular visits keep beds weeded, shrubs pruned and paths clear, and the green waste leaves with us.

Our garden maintenance Canberra rounds cover homes in Kambah and Greenway, unit complexes in Bruce and Macquarie, and rentals in Dickson and Lyneham. We are locally operated, fully insured and ABN registered, and work with residential and commercial properties. Quotes are free and given upfront before anything starts.

paras: Each visit covers the jobs that stop a garden sliding backwards. Weeding beds, paths and gravel. Pruning shrubs and hedges so they hold their shape. Cutting back perennials. Mulch top-ups where beds have thinned. Blowing paths, patios and driveways. If mowing is part of the property, it goes in the same visit.

Green waste is removed after every garden maintenance job. That matters for strata and rentals with no spare green bin, and it matters at home too. Our garden maintenance Canberra service includes the clean-up as standard, not as an extra line on the quote.
bullets: Pruning and shaping shrubs and hedges

sections.h2: How regular visits work for homes, rentals and strata
paras: Start with a call to 0423 720 317 or the form below. We walk the property with you or your property manager and agree a set scope and frequency. Every garden maintenance Canberra quote is free and given upfront, and for strata and body corporate committees the scope can be written up so everyone knows what is covered.

Once agreed, we turn up on the cycle without a reminder. Fortnightly suits most properties from spring to autumn. Monthly is usually enough through winter. For rentals, we time visits around inspections and open homes, and property managers get one contact for every garden on their books. The point of garden maintenance Canberra wide on a standing schedule is that nobody has to remember to book.

sections.h2: Keeping up with the Canberra garden calendar
paras: Canberra gardens are shaped by hard frosts from May to August, a spring growth surge from September, and hot, dry summers. Weeds in beds and bindi in lawns show up from late winter, so the first spring visits are heavy on weeding. Roses and deciduous shrubs are pruned in winter while frost-tender plants wait until the risk has passed.

Autumn leaf drop from the deciduous street trees in Lyneham and Dickson fills gutters, beds and paths for weeks, and those visits are mostly raking and bagging. Summer visits focus on mulch, light pruning and keeping paths clear with water restrictions in mind. Garden maintenance Canberra ACT wide follows this rhythm, which is why a fixed scope still shifts with the season.

sections.h2: Strata, body corporate and rental properties
paras: Common areas in unit and townhouse complexes need the same garden maintenance Canberra homes get, plus entries, bin areas and shared paths kept tidy for everyone. We work with strata managers and committees in Bruce, Macquarie and Greenway on standing schedules with a written scope.

For property managers, the garden maintenance Canberra rentals need is usually simple: keep it tidy, keep the tenant happy and have it looking right for the inspection. We can also do a one-off yard clean-up at the end of a lease.

faqs.q: Do you offer garden maintenance Canberra wide or just in Tuggeranong?
faqs.a: Tuggeranong, Belconnen and the Inner North are where most of our regular garden customers are, in suburbs like Kambah, Bruce and Dickson. We also work across Woden Valley, Weston Creek and the Inner South, and into Queanbeyan. Call 0423 720 317 with your address.

faqs.q: Can you look after a strata complex in Belconnen?
faqs.a: Yes. We maintain common areas for unit and townhouse complexes from a written scope agreed with the strata manager or committee. Visits run on a fixed cycle, we send a note when each is done, and green waste is removed every time so bin areas stay clear.

faqs.q: Do you take the green waste away after garden maintenance?
faqs.a: Yes, every time. Prunings, weeds and leaves are loaded and removed after each job, so nothing is left for tenants or residents to deal with and your green bin stays free. For bigger clean-outs, see our green waste removal page.

faqs.q: How often should a rental property garden be maintained?
faqs.a: Fortnightly from September to April and monthly through winter keeps most garden maintenance Canberra rentals presentable. Property managers often add a visit before routine inspections or an open home. We set the frequency to the property and adjust it as the seasons change.

faqs.q: Do I need to be there for the visit?
faqs.a: No. Once the scope is agreed, we work while you are out. Let us know about gate codes, pets or anything to avoid. You will get a message when the visit is done. For rentals, we can arrange access with the tenant or property manager directly.
